description: Admin UI: create the manual-payments Blade view, update the admin sidebar nav to add the Manual Payments link with pending-count badge. Depends on FEAT-001 (ManualPaymentController and routes must exist).
steps: Create resources/views/pages/admin/manual-payments.blade.php extending layouts.admin with @section('title', 'Manual Payments'). Follow the card/summary-grid/review-panel CSS patterns from resources/views/pages/admin/tutors.blade.php.

Section A (Pending Verification): a stats bar showing pending count. A table/panel list of pending_verification payments with columns: Time submitted, Student name+email, Amount (KSh), M-Pesa Code, Type (booking/clinic badge), Actions. Each row uses Alpine x-data for an accordion that shows either a Verify form (note textarea optional + POST to admin.manual-payments.verify) or a Reject form (reason textarea required + POST to admin.manual-payments.reject). Both forms include @csrf. Style verify button green, reject button red.

Section B (Recently Verified last 24h): a smaller table showing verified_at, student name, amount, code, status badge (success=green, failed=red), verified_by admin name, admin note. Only shown if $recentlyVerified is not empty.
Show flash messages: session('success') in green alert, session('error') in red alert at top of content.

In resources/views/layouts/admin.blade.php, inside the Finance nav section (after the Payout Requests nav-item at line ~217), insert the Manual Payments nav-item as specified in plan section 9. The badge queries Payment::where('status','pending_verification')->count() inline.
acceptance_criteria: php artisan optimize:clear succeeds with no view compilation errors
GET /admin/manual-payments returns HTTP 200 when logged in as admin
The admin sidebar shows 'Manual Payments' link under Finance section
A payment with status=pending_verification appears in the pending queue
Verify and Reject forms are present in each row
